<subject>HealthConnect Email Undeliverable: Cannot locate you</subject>
<body>
We received your email addressed to p953@trialttech.com. Unfortunately, we cannot find your username or email address listed as an active participant or registered user of HealthConnect.

Registration with HealthConnect is complimentary and enables you to access profiles of numerous healthcare professionals, post your own details, review your top clinical matchups, receive updates by email, and more. However, to initiate confidential communication with profiles that interest you, you must become a paid member. For more information, please visit: https://www.medisolve.fr/

If you are a current paid member and believe you have received this message by mistake, please reach out to our Clinical Operations team at: suzanne.bodin@lumieresante.fr

For your reference, we have included the text of your original message below:

To: p953@trialttech.com
Subject: RE: HealthConnect - You've Got Mail: Hi Plucci!
Hello,

Thank you for your email. I appreciate your interest and found your profile quite engaging as well. However, I feel at a bit of a disadvantage because your profile lacks a photo. Will you be sending one later, or should I just imagine what you look like? Drop me a line so we can clarify this.

Antoine
</body>
